description: Record parser whose cursor readers are generated by DEFINE_READER / DEFINE_STR_READER macros in src/readers.c

bugs.trigger: rec_parse: version byte 1, u16 count >= 1, item type 2 with label length byte exactly 16 and 16 label bytes; the generated read_label writes the NUL at out[16], past the caller's char label[LABEL_MAX] (stack)

decoys.why: src/dump_legacy.c is not in the Makefile's LIB_OBJS, so it is never compiled; called directly with len >= 17 it overflows char line[48]

lexer_expected: The lexer inventories no function in src/readers.c (read_u8/u16/u32 and read_label come from macro invocations with no top-level braces), so module 'record' lists them as external callees and its required_sources is only src/record.c: the rec_parse/rec_sum harness fails to link (undefined read_u8, read_u16, read_u32, read_label; verified) and S01-1 is missed. It also walks src/dump_legacy.c and offers rec_dump_legacy as the entry point of module 'dump_legacy'; that harness crashes at line 15 (false positive, verified).

trust.rule: step I7, no threat model: a library alone, so its API is untrusted (default, boundary) and every other function trusted (default)
